title: Senior Manager, Forward Deployed Engineer
description: Use Your Power for Purpose At Pfizer, technology drives everything we do. You will play a pivotal role in implementing impactful and innovative technology solutions across all functions, from research to manufacturing. Whether you are digitizing drug discovery and development, identifying innovative solutions, or streamlining our processes, you will be making a significant impact on countless lives. ROLE SUMMARY Take the hardest AI problems in Finance & Global Business Services (GBS) from whiteboard to production, and set the patterns the rest of the team builds on. As Senior Manager, Forward Deployed Engineer, you join a Finance & GBS function team, define the problem, and lead the build from first prototype through production handoff and support. You take the engagements that span multiple systems or teams. You work on engagements in areas such as financial close, forecasting, accounts receivable, procure-to-pay, tax, treasury, shared services operations, and other F&GBS functions. We measure success through adoption and demonstrable business outcomes, including time saved, improved quality, reduced risk, stronger controls, faster cycle times, better decisions, and measurable financial impact, and by how much of your work the rest of the team can reuse. This is a senior hands-on individual contributor and technical lead role within the F&GBS Technology & AI Solutions Capability Center in Chennai. You set the engineering patterns other Forward Deployed Engineers follow, review their designs and code, and still write code every week. You work alongside Product Owners, function leaders, finance analysts, process owners, and Digital platform and architecture teams. WHY THIS ROLE You work directly with Finance and GBS leaders worldwide, so you find out fast whether what you build works. You lead the design of agentic AI built with frontier models on Pfizer’s enterprise AI platforms, connected to SAP, Snowflake, Oracle EPM, and custom solutions through MCP or direct API integration. You help shape a shared F&GBS Data & AI Foundation (ontology, rules engine, MCP tool library, and decision ledger), and decide which patterns become shared building blocks. Your influence grows through technical leadership and the patterns others reuse. You can grow your career without moving into people management. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Problem Discovery & Business Partnership Work in person in Chennai within the F&GBS Technology & AI Solutions Capability Center, while embedding virtually with assigned Finance and GBS teams. Lead discovery for complex, cross-functional use cases through regular calls, screen-share walkthroughs, and process reviews, and shape them into roadmaps with measurable outcomes. Run discovery with senior business stakeholders and process owners across regions, including the US and Europe. Work with Product Owners to turn priorities and specifications into solution designs and delivery plans, and to rank use cases by value, feasibility, and risk. Say no, or not yet, when a use case lacks data, sponsorship, or a clear value case, and push back when a specification doesn’t match the underlying problem or runs into technical issues and limitations. Technical Leadership & Build Serve as technical lead on complex engagements. Own solution design and stay hands-on in the code. Design multi-agent and multi-step workflows on Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI, and other market-leading runtimes, using frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, and LangChain, with MCP, A2A, and APIs connecting enterprise systems, deterministic business rules, and human approval steps. Set coding standards, evaluation practice, and quality bars for the engagements you lead, including review standards for AI-generated code. Use AI coding agents in your daily workflow to speed delivery, and show other engineers how to use them well. Make build-versus-buy and platform choices with Digital platform and architecture teams. Data & Enterprise Integration Lead integration across Finance and GBS data and systems through governed MCP tools or APIs and certified data products, such as SAP S/4HANA, Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, SAP Ariba and Business Network, Oracle EPM, Microsoft 365, and other enterprise platforms. Define data contracts, semantic models, and access patterns, and extend the shared F&GBS ontology and business rules (such as Delegation of Authority, Segregation of Duties, and materiality) that other engineers and agents reuse. Set data access, entitlement, and classification practice for financial and personal data on the engagements you lead. Controls, Compliance & Responsible AI Own control design for your solutions. Engage SOX, Internal Audit, Privacy, Legal, Security, and AI governance early, including data privacy (GDPR, India DPDP Act) and EU AI Act review, and pass required gates before release. Define evaluation and monitoring for accuracy, drift, and failure modes on financial outputs, and make sure agent evidence, approvals, and actions are recorded in the decision ledger. Enforce Pfizer responsible AI safeguards: data access controls, prompt injection defenses, human review, and output monitoring. Production, Reliability & Reuse Own production readiness and ongoing support for the solutions you lead: LLMOps practice, deployment pipelines, monitoring, incident response, and run costs. Establish support ownership, runbooks, service expectations, escalation paths, knowledge transfer, and root cause analysis for production solutions. Set the standard for logging, tracing, monitoring, and alerting with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Foundry Observability. Convert proven solutions into reusable components, templates, and accelerators across Finance and GBS. Identify and pay down technical debt before it blocks scale. Mentoring & Practice Building Mentor Manager-level FDEs, and engineers in F&GBS function teams, through design reviews, pairing, and code review. Contribute to FDE playbooks, interview loops, and team upskilling. Value & Adoption Build business cases and track realized value: hours saved, cycle time, cost avoidance, and risk reduction. Present results and tradeoffs to senior Finance and GBS stakeholders and FDE leadership. Build champions in the business so adoption sticks. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS You can partner with the business, turn messy problems into working solutions, and show the impact in numbers. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, with [9+] years of software or data engineering experience. 3+ years building and shipping LLM-based applications to production, including at least one multi-step agentic system with tool use, evaluation, and monitoring. Technical lead experience on complex, multi-system builds. Expert-level Python, with strong TypeScript/JavaScript and SQL. Hands-on experience with Azure (preferred) or AWS cloud architecture, API-first design, CI/CD, and observability. Hands-on LLMOps practice: evaluation, tracing, and prompt, model, and agent versioning. Proven ability to influence senior business stakeholders without formal authority. Experience mentoring engineers. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Master’s degree in a technical field, or a finance/accounting background combined with engineering experience. Deep knowledge of finance processes such as record-to-report, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, FP&A, or treasury, or prior work in finance technology. Experience integrating with SAP (S/4HANA, GTS, Ariba), Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, the Azure AI stack (AI Foundry, AI Search, Document Intelligence, Azure ML), Vertex AI, or Oracle EPM. Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, LangChain), MCP server development, and A2A. Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs, or rules engines. Experience with SOX and IT general controls in a regulated industry. Experience turning bespoke solutions into reusable platforms or products. Relevant certifications (AWS or Azure Solutions Architect or Developer, or equivalent on other market-leading platforms). You don’t need every item on this list. If you’ve led AI into production that people use and you want to work close to the business, we want to hear from you. NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL, OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS Regular overlap with US and European time zones is required, including some early-evening IST calls. Must be able to travel to Pfizer offices and partner sites when required, including occasional international travel. Work can be demanding at times, including support during period-end close and leading the response to production incidents. Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers. Information & Business Tech

title: Senior Manager, Forward Deployed Engineer
description: Use Your Power for Purpose At Pfizer, technology drives everything we do. You will play a pivotal role in implementing impactful and innovative technology solutions across all functions, from research to manufacturing. Whether you are digitizing drug discovery and development, identifying innovative solutions, or streamlining our processes, you will be making a significant impact on countless lives. ROLE SUMMARY Take the hardest AI problems in Finance & Global Business Services (GBS) from whiteboard to production, and set the patterns the rest of the team builds on. As Senior Manager, Forward Deployed Engineer, you join a Finance & GBS function team, define the problem, and lead the build from first prototype through production handoff and support. You take the engagements that span multiple systems or teams. You work on engagements in areas such as financial close, forecasting, accounts receivable, procure-to-pay, tax, treasury, shared services operations, and other F&GBS functions. We measure success through adoption and demonstrable business outcomes, including time saved, improved quality, reduced risk, stronger controls, faster cycle times, better decisions, and measurable financial impact, and by how much of your work the rest of the team can reuse. This is a senior hands-on individual contributor and technical lead role within the F&GBS Technology & AI Solutions Capability Center in Chennai. You set the engineering patterns other Forward Deployed Engineers follow, review their designs and code, and still write code every week. You work alongside Product Owners, function leaders, finance analysts, process owners, and Digital platform and architecture teams. WHY THIS ROLE You work directly with Finance and GBS leaders worldwide, so you find out fast whether what you build works. You lead the design of agentic AI built with frontier models on Pfizer’s enterprise AI platforms, connected to SAP, Snowflake, Oracle EPM, and custom solutions through MCP or direct API integration. You help shape a shared F&GBS Data & AI Foundation (ontology, rules engine, MCP tool library, and decision ledger), and decide which patterns become shared building blocks. Your influence grows through technical leadership and the patterns others reuse. You can grow your career without moving into people management. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Problem Discovery & Business Partnership Work in person in Chennai within the F&GBS Technology & AI Solutions Capability Center, while embedding virtually with assigned Finance and GBS teams. Lead discovery for complex, cross-functional use cases through regular calls, screen-share walkthroughs, and process reviews, and shape them into roadmaps with measurable outcomes. Run discovery with senior business stakeholders and process owners across regions, including the US and Europe. Work with Product Owners to turn priorities and specifications into solution designs and delivery plans, and to rank use cases by value, feasibility, and risk. Say no, or not yet, when a use case lacks data, sponsorship, or a clear value case, and push back when a specification doesn’t match the underlying problem or runs into technical issues and limitations. Technical Leadership & Build Serve as technical lead on complex engagements. Own solution design and stay hands-on in the code. Design multi-agent and multi-step workflows on Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI, and other market-leading runtimes, using frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, and LangChain, with MCP, A2A, and APIs connecting enterprise systems, deterministic business rules, and human approval steps. Set coding standards, evaluation practice, and quality bars for the engagements you lead, including review standards for AI-generated code. Use AI coding agents in your daily workflow to speed delivery, and show other engineers how to use them well. Make build-versus-buy and platform choices with Digital platform and architecture teams. Data & Enterprise Integration Lead integration across Finance and GBS data and systems through governed MCP tools or APIs and certified data products, such as SAP S/4HANA, Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, SAP Ariba and Business Network, Oracle EPM, Microsoft 365, and other enterprise platforms. Define data contracts, semantic models, and access patterns, and extend the shared F&GBS ontology and business rules (such as Delegation of Authority, Segregation of Duties, and materiality) that other engineers and agents reuse. Set data access, entitlement, and classification practice for financial and personal data on the engagements you lead. Controls, Compliance & Responsible AI Own control design for your solutions. Engage SOX, Internal Audit, Privacy, Legal, Security, and AI governance early, including data privacy (GDPR, India DPDP Act) and EU AI Act review, and pass required gates before release. Define evaluation and monitoring for accuracy, drift, and failure modes on financial outputs, and make sure agent evidence, approvals, and actions are recorded in the decision ledger. Enforce Pfizer responsible AI safeguards: data access controls, prompt injection defenses, human review, and output monitoring. Production, Reliability & Reuse Own production readiness and ongoing support for the solutions you lead: LLMOps practice, deployment pipelines, monitoring, incident response, and run costs. Establish support ownership, runbooks, service expectations, escalation paths, knowledge transfer, and root cause analysis for production solutions. Set the standard for logging, tracing, monitoring, and alerting with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Foundry Observability. Convert proven solutions into reusable components, templates, and accelerators across Finance and GBS. Identify and pay down technical debt before it blocks scale. Mentoring & Practice Building Mentor Manager-level FDEs, and engineers in F&GBS function teams, through design reviews, pairing, and code review. Contribute to FDE playbooks, interview loops, and team upskilling. Value & Adoption Build business cases and track realized value: hours saved, cycle time, cost avoidance, and risk reduction. Present results and tradeoffs to senior Finance and GBS stakeholders and FDE leadership. Build champions in the business so adoption sticks. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS You can partner with the business, turn messy problems into working solutions, and show the impact in numbers. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, with [9+] years of software or data engineering experience. 3+ years building and shipping LLM-based applications to production, including at least one multi-step agentic system with tool use, evaluation, and monitoring. Technical lead experience on complex, multi-system builds. Expert-level Python, with strong TypeScript/JavaScript and SQL. Hands-on experience with Azure (preferred) or AWS cloud architecture, API-first design, CI/CD, and observability. Hands-on LLMOps practice: evaluation, tracing, and prompt, model, and agent versioning. Proven ability to influence senior business stakeholders without formal authority. Experience mentoring engineers. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Master’s degree in a technical field, or a finance/accounting background combined with engineering experience. Deep knowledge of finance processes such as record-to-report, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, FP&A, or treasury, or prior work in finance technology. Experience integrating with SAP (S/4HANA, GTS, Ariba), Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, the Azure AI stack (AI Foundry, AI Search, Document Intelligence, Azure ML), Vertex AI, or Oracle EPM. Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, LangChain), MCP server development, and A2A. Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs, or rules engines. Experience with SOX and IT general controls in a regulated industry. Experience turning bespoke solutions into reusable platforms or products. Relevant certifications (AWS or Azure Solutions Architect or Developer, or equivalent on other market-leading platforms). You don’t need every item on this list. If you’ve led AI into production that people use and you want to work close to the business, we want to hear from you. NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL, OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS Regular overlap with US and European time zones is required, including some early-evening IST calls. Must be able to travel to Pfizer offices and partner sites when required, including occasional international travel. Work can be demanding at times, including support during period-end close and leading the response to production incidents. Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers. Information & Business Tech
